Fourth pre-release of 1.3 — the one-time Calibre import and layout details from testing beta3.

## New

- **Import from a Calibre library.** *File > Import from Calibre library …* (also in *Complete ▾* in Metadata) takes Calibre's metadata over into your books once, so you can stop using Calibre. Choose the library folder (the one with `metadata.db`); it is only read, Calibre may stay open. Books are matched by Calibre ID, ISBN or title and author; a table lists every differing field with a tick box (*All differences* or *Only empty fields*, blurbs optional), unmatched books are listed separately. Own Calibre columns such as `#subtitle` can be added as own fields in one go. *Apply ticked* marks the books yellow, then save.

## Changed

- **Two-line sidebar entries.** The sidebar grows to at most 250 px; if an area has more markers than fit next to its name, they move to a second line below it.
- **Status column in the library.** Dot and pictograms are now a real column (*Status*, always on the left): hide or show it with a right-click on a column header, drag its width, click it to sort (unreadable files first, then the books with the most markers). As long as you have not dragged a column width, the columns fit the window whenever it is resized.
- **Resizable book lists.** Drag the divider right of the book lists in Chapters, Metadata, Preview and Dictionary; the width is remembered, a double-click restores the default. Names that do not fit are shown in full when you hover over them.
- **Metadata form scrolls.** If you drag the blurb large, the form above gets a scrollbar instead of losing fields.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3-beta4.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
